incidents.name: SynapLogic sale proxy unbounded referral rebates
incidents.notes: The SYP sale proxy's buy path (selector 0x670a3267) paid a 10% rebate to every entry of a caller-supplied referrer array without bounding its length or checking that total payouts stayed under the payment received, so repeating the buyer's own address 31 times returned about 310% of each purchase in ETH and USDC.

sources.ref: onchain review: sale proxy created 2025-10-12 by 0xaf4d0fe93eeddabbd4ddb7451f09e6359575c214 (not the attacker); EIP-1967 impl slot held 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371 - the implementation named as vulnerable in the PoC - and the six Upgraded events on the proxy all land at Base blocks 41047082+, after the attack at block 41038634, so they are the emergency response, not a pre-incident change. Loss ~27.6 ETH + ~3,450 USDC; DefiLlama records $144,000 while smartcontractshacking.com lists $186,000. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): rather than relying on the Upgraded events, the EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x3608...382bbc was binary-searched with eth_getStorageAt over [36732639, 41038633] and held 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371 unchanged for the whole pre-incident life of the proxy; that is also the only address the victim delegatecalls in the exploit trace (selector 0x670a3267). Confirms the six Upgraded events are post-incident and deployment is the right basis.
